audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer calls Mourning Mist the cage ('his E mist can slow-and-cage you', 'E-cage') in five places. The cage is Dark Procession, his W. The page also never says the cage is destructible.
audit.why: Riot text, W Dark Procession: 'Yorick summons a destructible wall at target location that will block enemy movement' — 20/18/16/14/12s, 600 range. E Mourning Mist: 'throws a globule of Black Mist that reduces armor, damages, slows and marks enemies. Summoned units gain move speed when moving towards marked targets' — 12/11/10/9/8s, 700 range. Two different abilities doing two different jobs, and the mark-drives-the-swarm effect is the one that actually kills a kiting Lillia. Destructibility matters enormously to her: she can break a segment and leave rather than being held for the collapse.
audit.corrected: W named as the cage and stated as destructible with its cooldown; E restated as the slow/armour-shred/mark that aims his ghouls.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown given for either the cage or the mist despite both being described as the lane's clock.
audit.why: Dark Procession is 12-20s, Mourning Mist 8-12s, Last Rites 4-6s with a heal attached.
audit.corrected: All three written into breakdown.cooldowns; the cage window also in dosFull[0].d and report[5].

notes: The E-is-the-cage confusion still survives in content whys[6], spikes[1], spikes[3], early, mid, late, wants.you[0] and wants.you[1] — I fixed the two shortest carriers plus the whole full layer, but a follow-up pass should replace every remaining 'E-cage' with 'W cage' since the two abilities have different ranges and cooldowns and a player timing the wrong one will step into the wall.
